+        howItPlays: 'With buildCourse (the default) the game builds its own course on the first join: a line of platforms going east from startPosition (or, with courseShape "tower", a climb spiralling up around startPosition, a block higher every jump) in `stages` stages of `jumpsPerStage` jumps, a checkpointBlock pad at the start of each stage and the finishBlock at the end. +        code: '// Parkour: race from the start to the finish block. A checkpoint block saves your progress; falling, a kill block or\n// dying sends you back to it. /restart starts again. With CONFIG.buildCourse the game builds the course itself, in\n// stages that get harder.\nconst checkpoints = {}\nconst checkpointCounts = {}\nlet courseStarted = false\nlet coursePlan = []\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tif (CONFIG.buildCourse && !courseStarted) {\n\t\tcourseStarted = true\n\t\tcoursePlan = planCourse()\n\t\tconst start = CONFIG.startPosition\n\t\twhenWorldLoaded([start[0], start[1] - 1, start[2]], () => placeCourse(coursePlan))\n\t}\n\tsendToStart(playerId)\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Reach the " + CONFIG.finishBlock + "! Stand on " + CONFIG.checkpointBlock + " to save your progress. Type /restart to start again.", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\nfunction stageCount() {\n\treturn Math.max(1, Math.min(50, Math.floor(CONFIG.stages)))\n}\n\n// The course as a list of parts { from, to, block, stage, pad }, going east from startPosition. (stage - 1) / (stages - 1) : 0\n\t\tfor (let jump = 0; jump <= jumps; jump++) {\n\t\t\tconst pad = jump === 0\n\t\t\tif (stage === 1 && pad) {\n\t\t\t\tadd(-1, 3, 1, CONFIG.checkpointBlock, 1, true)\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tconst wanted = hard < 0.2 ? 0 : rises[count % rises.length]\n\t\t\tconst rise = y + wanted < start[1] - 3 ? 0 : wanted\n\t\t\tlet gap = count % 2 === 0 ? 1 + Math.round(hard * 2) : Math.max(1, Math.round(hard * 2))\n\t\t\tgap = Math.min(gap, rise > 0 ? 2 : 3)\n\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\ty += rise\n\t\t\tif (pad) {\n\t\t\t\tadd(end + gap + 1, 3, 1, CONFIG.checkpointBlock, stage, true)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tadd(end + gap + 1, hard < 0.7 ? 2 : 1, hard < 0.5 ? 1 : 0, CONFIG.courseBlock, stage, false)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tadd(end + 3, 3, 1, CONFIG.finishBlock, stages, false)\n\treturn parts\n}\n\n// The tower: platforms on a 9 by 9 square ring with the start at a corner, each one a block higher than the last, with\n// gaps of 1 to 2 blocks (the most a jump up can clear), smaller platforms as the stages go up\nfunction planTower(start) {\n\tconst side = 8\n\tconst stages = stageCount()\n\tconst jumps = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, Math.floor(CONFIG.jumpsPerStage)))\n\tconst parts = []\n\tlet along = 0 // how far round the ring\n\tlet y = start[1] - 1\n\tlet wide = 1\n\tlet last = [0, 0]\n\tfunction ringSpot(at) {\n\t\tconst offset = at % side\n\t\tconst edge = Math.floor(at / side) % 4\n\t\treturn edge === 0 ? [offset, 0] : edge === 1 ? [side, offset] : edge === 2 ? [side - offset, side] : [0, side - offset]\n\t}\n\tfunction add(width, block, stage, pad) {\n\t\tconst spot = ringSpot(along)\n\t\tparts.push({ from: [start[0] + spot[0] - width, y, start[2] + spot[1] - width], to: [start[0] + spot[0] + width, y, start[2] + spot[1] + width], block: block, stage: stage, pad: pad })\n\t\twide = width\n\t\tlast = spot\n\t}\n\t// Goes round the ring until the next platform is gap blocks from the last one, edge to edge (less far round at corners)\n\tfunction moveOn(gap, width) {\n\t\tlet spot\n\t\tdo {\n\t\t\talong++\n\t\t\tspot = ringSpot(along)\n\t\t} while (Math.max(Math.abs(spot[0] - last[0]), Math.abs(spot[1] - last[1])) - wide - width - 1 < gap)\n\t}\n\tadd(1, CONFIG.checkpointBlock, 1, true)\n\tfor (let stage = 1; stage <= stages; stage++) {\n\t\tconst hard = stages > 1 ? +        code: '// Zombie waves: mobs come in waves around spawnCenter, each wave bigger than the last. Kill them for coins and get\n// ready in the break between waves. If every player is dead at once it\'s game over; clear maxWaves to win.\nlet wave = 0\nlet wavePhase = "waiting" // waiting, break, fighting, over\nconst waveMobIds = {}\nlet lastShown = ""\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, CONFIG.spawnCenter[0], CONFIG.spawnCenter[1], CONFIG.spawnCenter[2])\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Survive the waves of " + CONFIG.mobType + "s! +        code: '// Bed Wars: every team has a bed. While your bed stands, you come back at your team\'s spawn after dying. Break the\n// other teams\' beds (not your own!) so they can\'t come back, then knock them out. The last team left wins.\nconst bedsStanding = {}\nlet generatorTimer = null\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tjoinSmallestTeam(playerId)\n\tif (isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\teliminate(playerId)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "A round is on: watch this one, you\'ll play in the next!", { color: "yellow" })\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tapi.setPlayerGamemode(playerId, "survival")\n\tsendToSpawn(playerId)\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Welcome to Bed Wars! Protect your bed and break the others.", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\nfunction teamSpawn(team) {\n\treturn CONFIG.teamSpawns[CONFIG.teamNames.indexOf(team)] || CONFIG.teamSpawns[0]\n}\n\nfunction teamBed(team) {\n\tconst bed = CONFIG.bedPositions[CONFIG.teamNames.indexOf(team)] || CONFIG.bedPositions[0]\n\treturn [Math.floor(bed[0]), Math.floor(bed[1]), Math.floor(bed[2])]\n}\n\nfunction sendToSpawn(playerId) {\n\tconst spot = teamSpawn(getTeam(playerId))\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, spot[0], spot[1], spot[2])\n}\n\nfunction beginRound() {\n\tbringEveryoneBack()\n\tevenTeams()\n\tCONFIG.teamNames.forEach((team, index) => {\n\t\tconst bed = teamBed(team)\n\t\tbedsStanding[team] = teamMembers(team).length > 0\n\t\tif (bedsStanding[team]) {\n\t\t\tapi.setBlock(bed[0], bed[1], bed[2], CONFIG.bedBlocks[index] || CONFIG.bedBlocks[0])\n\t\t}\n\t})\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.forceRespawn(playerId, teamSpawn(getTeam(playerId)))\n\t\t}\n\t\tsendToSpawn(playerId)\n\t\thealFully(playerId)\n\t\tgiveKit(playerId, CONFIG.startItems)\n\t}\n\tgeneratorTimer = repeatEvery(CONFIG.generatorSeconds, runGenerators)\n\tannounce("Protect your bed and break the others!", "aqua")\n}\n\n// After players leave, one team can be much bigger: move players from the biggest team until the teams are even\nfunction evenTeams() {\n\tfor (let i = 0; i < api.getPlayerIds().length; i++) {\n\t\tconst sizes = CONFIG.teamNames.map((team) => teamMembers(team).length)\n\t\tif (Math.max(...sizes) - Math.min(...sizes) <= 1) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst biggest = CONFIG.teamNames[sizes.indexOf(Math.max(...sizes))]\n\t\tjoinSmallestTeam(teamMembers(biggest)[0])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction finishRound() {\n\tcancelTimer(generatorTimer)\n\t// Those knocked out play again, waiting at their spawn for the next round\n\tconst left = playersLeft()\n\tconst out = api.getPlayerIds().filter((playerId) => !left.includes(playerId))\n\tbringEveryoneBack()\n\tfor (const playerId of out) {\n\t\tif (api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tsendToSpawn(playerId)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Gives every player still in the round their team generator\'s items\nfunction runGenerators() {\n\tfor (const playerId of playersLeft()) {\n\t\tif (getTeam(playerId) !== null && api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.giveItem(playerId, CONFIG.resourceItem, CONFIG.resourceAmount)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// The team whose bed is at (or right next to) x, y, z, or null\nfunction bedOwnerAt(x, y, z) {\n\tfor (const team of CONFIG.teamNames) {\n\t\tconst bed = teamBed(team)\n\t\tif (Math.abs(x - bed[0]) <= 1 && y === bed[1] && Math.abs(z - bed[2]) <= 1) {\n\t\t\treturn team\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn null\n}\n\n// A bed\'s foot ("Red Bed") or head ("_Red Bed Head"), not Bedrock\nfunction isBedBlock(block) {\n\treturn / Bed( Head)?$/.test(block)\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerAttemptChangeBlock(playerId, x, y, z, fromBlock, toBlock) {\n\tconst team = isBedBlock(fromBlock) ? bedOwnerAt(x, y, z) : null\n\tif (team === null) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif (!isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\treturn "preventChange"\n\t}\n\tif (team === getTeam(playerId)) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "That\'s your own bed! +        code: '// Grow a garden: buy seeds with coins (/seeds, /buyseed), place them on the soil and wait. A ripe plant gives fruit when\n// broken, which /sell or the sell pad turns into coins. Some harvests are golden. Plants keep growing while players are away.\nconst plants = {}\nconst lastNotice = {}\nlet gardenStarted = false\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tstartGarden()\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Welcome to the garden! Type /seeds to see seeds. Place them on " + CONFIG.soilBlock + ", break them when ripe, then /sell.", { color: "aqua" })\n\tshowGarden(playerId)\n}\n\nfunction startGarden() {\n\tif (gardenStarted) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tgardenStarted = true\n\taddCommand("seeds", (playerId) => listSeeds(playerId))\n\taddCommand("buyseed", (playerId, args) => buySeeds(playerId, args))\n\taddCommand("sell", (playerId) => sellCommand(playerId))\n\taddCommand("sellcrops", (playerId) => sellCommand(playerId))\n\trepeatEvery(1, growPlants)\n}\n\nfunction plantKey(x, y, z) {\n\treturn x + "," + y + "," + z\n}\n\nfunction cropNumber(seedBlock) {\n\treturn CONFIG.crops.findIndex((crop) => crop[0] === seedBlock)\n}\n\n// 0 seed, 1 sprout, 2 ripe\nfunction stageOf(plant) {\n\tconst age = (Date.now() - plant.start) / 1000\n\tconst grow = CONFIG.crops[plant.crop][5]\n\treturn age >= grow ? 2 : age >= grow / 2 ? 1 : 0\n}\n\nfunction blockForStage(crop, stage) {\n\treturn [crop[0], crop[1] + "_stage1", crop[1] + "|FreshlyGrown"][stage]\n}\n\n// The same message at most every 1.5 seconds, as a player holding the break button would see it over and over\nfunction notice(playerId, text) {\n\tconst last = lastNotice[playerId]\n\tif (!last || last.text !== text || Date.now() - last.at > 1500) {\n\t\tlastNotice[playerId] = { text: text, at: Date.now() }\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, text, { color: "orange" })\n\t}\n}\n\n// Every second: shows each plant at its stage, forgets lost ones, sells for players on the pad and updates the sidebar\nfunction growPlants() {\n\tlet ripe = 0\n\tlet total = 0\n\tfor (const key of Object.keys(plants)) {\n\t\tconst plant = plants[key]\n\t\tconst there = api.getBlock(plant.x, plant.y, plant.z)\n\t\tif (there === "Unloaded") {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (there === "Air") {\n\t\t\tdelete plants[key]\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst stage = stageOf(plant)\n\t\tconst wanted = blockForStage(CONFIG.crops[plant.crop], stage)\n\t\tif (there !== wanted) {\n\t\t\tapi.setBlock(plant.x, plant.y, plant.z, wanted)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (there !== wanted || !plant.frozen) {\n\t\t\t// The game\'s own farming would grow it on its own clock: this puts that off for good\n\t\t\tapi.setBlockData(plant.x, plant.y, plant.z, { growTime: Date.now() + 1e13 })\n\t\t\tplant.frozen = true\n\t\t}\n\t\ttotal++\n\t\tripe += stage === 2 ? 1 : 0\n\t}\n\tconst pad = CONFIG.sellPad\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tif (isInBox(playerId, [pad[0] - 1, pad[1], pad[2] - 1], [pad[0] + 1, pad[1] + 3, pad[2] + 1])) {\n\t\t\tsellFruit(playerId)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Ripe plants", ripe + " of " + total)\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Fruit worth", fruitWorth(playerId) + " coins")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction fruitWorth(playerId) {\n\treturn CONFIG.crops.reduce((sum, crop) => sum + Math.max(0, api.getInventoryItemAmount(playerId, crop[2])) * crop[4], 0)\n}\n\nfunction showGarden(playerId) {\n\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Fruit worth", fruitWorth(playerId) + " coins")\n}\n\nfunction listSeeds(playerId) {\n\tconst lines = CONFIG.crops.map((crop, index) => (index + 1) + ". " + crop[0] + ": " + crop[3] + " coins, fruit sells for " + crop[4] + ", ready in " + crop[5] + "s")\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Seeds:\\n" + lines.join("\\n") + "\\nBuy with /buyseed and a name or number, like /buyseed carrot 3", { color: "yellow" })\n}\n\nfunction buySeeds(playerId, args) {\n\tconst words = args.slice()\n\tlet amount = 1\n\tif (words.length > 1 && Number.isInteger(Number(words[words.length - 1]))) {\n\t\tamount = Math.min(64, Math.max(1, Number(words.pop())))\n\t}\n\tconst wanted = words.join(" ").toLowerCase()\n\tconst index = wanted !== "" && Number.isInteger(Number(wanted)) ? +        code: '// City roleplay: /jobs lists the jobs and /job <name> picks one, giving its kit. Everyone is paid for their job every\n// payEverySeconds. Stand in a house and type /buy to buy it: then only you can build in it, and /home takes you there.\n// Coins, jobs and houses are saved.\nconst jobOf = {}\nconst kitDue = {}\nlet payTimer = null\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, CONFIG.spawnPosition[0], CONFIG.spawnPosition[1], CONFIG.spawnPosition[2])\n\tjobOf[playerId] = findJob(String(getSaved(playerId, "job", "")))\n\tif (jobOf[playerId]) {\n\t\tgiveKit(playerId, jobOf[playerId][1])\n\t}\n\tlockHouses(playerId)\n\tupdateSidebar(playerId)\n\tif (payTimer === null) {\n\t\tpayTimer = repeatEvery(Math.max(1, CONFIG.payEverySeconds), payEveryone)\n\t}\n\tconst welcome = jobOf[playerId] ? "Welcome back! You work as " + jobOf[playerId][0] + "." : "Welcome to the city! Type /jobs to pick a job and start earning."\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, welcome, { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\n// A job by its name, the start of its name or its number in the list; null if there\'s none\nfunction findJob(wanted) {\n\tconst name = wanted.trim().toLowerCase()\n\tconst number = Number(name)\n\tif (name !== "" && Number.isInteger(number) && number >= 1 && number <= CONFIG.jobs.length) {\n\t\treturn CONFIG.jobs[number - 1]\n\t}\n\treturn name === "" ? null : CONFIG.jobs.find((job) => job[0].toLowerCase() === name) || CONFIG.jobs.find((job) => job[0].toLowerCase().startsWith(name)) || null\n}\n\nfunction payFor(job) {\n\treturn Math.round((job[2] * CONFIG.payEverySeconds) / 60)\n}\n\nfunction listJobs(playerId) {\n\tconst lines = CONFIG.jobs.map((job, index) => index + 1 + ". " + job[0] + ": " + payFor(job) + " coins every " + CONFIG.payEverySeconds + " seconds")\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Jobs:\\n" + lines.join("\\n") + "\\nType /job and a name, like /job " + CONFIG.jobs[0][0], { color: "yellow" })\n}\n\nfunction pickJob(playerId, wanted) {\n\tconst job = findJob(wanted)\n\tif (job === null) {\n\t\tlistJobs(playerId)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tjobOf[playerId] = job\n\tsetSaved(playerId, "job", job[0])\n\tgiveKit(playerId, job[1])\n\tupdateSidebar(playerId)\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You are now a " + job[0] + "! You earn " + payFor(job) + " coins every " + CONFIG.payEverySeconds + " seconds.", { color: "lime" })\n}\n\nfunction payEveryone() {\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tif (jobOf[playerId]) {\n\t\t\tpaySalary(playerId, jobOf[playerId])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction paySalary(playerId, job) {\n\taddCoins(playerId, payFor(job))\n\tupdateSidebar(playerId)\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Payday! +" + payFor(job) + " coins for your work as " + job[0] + ".", { color: "lime" })\n}\n\n// A house\'s owner is kept for the lobby, so it stays theirs after they leave\nfunction ownsHouse(playerId, index) {\n\treturn api.getLobbyDbValue("house" + index) === String(api.getPlayerDbId(playerId))\n}\n\n// Nobody can change blocks in a house but its owner\nfunction lockHouses(playerId) {\n\tCONFIG.houses.forEach((house, index) => {\n\t\tif (ownsHouse(playerId, index)) {\n\t\t\tapi.resetCanChangeBlockRect(playerId, house[0].slice(), house[1].slice())\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tapi.setCantChangeBlockRect(playerId, house[0].slice(), house[1].slice())\n\t\t}\n\t})\n}\n\nfunction buyHouse(playerId) {\n\tconst index = CONFIG.houses.findIndex((house) => isInBox(playerId, house[0], house[1]))\n\tconst house = CONFIG.houses[index]\n\tif (index === -1) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Stand inside a house for sale, then type /buy.", { color: "yellow" })\n\t} else if (ownsHouse(playerId, index)) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "This is already your house!", { color: "yellow" })\n\t} else if (api.getLobbyDbValue("house" + index) !== null) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Sorry, this house belongs to " + api.getLobbyDbValue("houseName" + index) + ".", { color: "red" })\n\t} else if (!spendCoins(playerId, house[2])) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "This house costs " + house[2] + " coins. You have " + getCoins(playerId) + ".", { color: "red" })\n\t} else {\n\t\tapi.setLobbyDbValue("house" + index, String(api.getPlayerDbId(playerId)))\n\t\tapi.setLobbyDbValue("houseName" + index, api.getEntityName(playerId))\n\t\tlockHouses(playerId)\n\t\tupdateSidebar(playerId)\n\t\tapi.broadcastMessage(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " bought a house!", { color: "lime" })\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction goHome(playerId) {\n\tconst house = CONFIG.houses.find((house, index) => ownsHouse(playerId, index))\n\tif (!house) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You don\'t have a house yet. +        code: '// Plots: every player gets their own square plot; only they can build on it, and /plot takes them back to it.\n// "free" mode: a player keeps their plot for good. "battle" mode: a theme is announced, everyone builds it on a fresh\n// plot, then everyone visits each build and rates it 1 to 5. The best rated build wins.\nconst maxPlots = 40 // free mode: plots are kept for good, so after this many players newcomers get none\nconst plotHeight = 40 // how high players can build above the floor\nconst floorBlock = "Grass Block"\nconst buildGamemode = "creative" // "survival": players build with the blocks they have\nconst battleCountdown = 10\nconst plotOf = {} // a player: their plot\'s number\nconst buildRects = {} // a player: the boxes they can\'t build in\nconst clearQueue = [] // plots waiting to be cleared: { plot, layer }\nlet phase = "waiting" // battle mode: waiting, countdown, building, voting or break\nlet builders = []\nlet ratings = {} // a builder: { a voter: 1 to 5 }\nlet tour = []\nlet showing = null // the builder whose plot everyone is rating\nlet phaseTimer = null\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tapi.setPlayerGamemode(playerId, buildGamemode)\n\tconst plot = CONFIG.mode === "battle" ? null : findPlot(playerId)\n\tsetBuildArea(playerId, plot)\n\tif (CONFIG.mode === "battle") {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Welcome to Build Battle! Build the theme in time, then rate everyone\'s builds.", { color: "aqua" })\n\t} else if (plot === null) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Sorry, every plot is taken!", { color: "red" })\n\t} else {\n\t\tplotOf[playerId] = plot\n\t\tgoToPlot(playerId, plot)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "This is your plot! Only you can build here. Type /plot to come back.", { color: "aqua" })\n\t}\n}\n\n// Free mode: the plot this player had before, else the next one nobody has had (kept for the lobby)\nfunction findPlot(playerId) {\n\tconst me = String(api.getPlayerDbId(playerId))\n\tlet free = null\n\tfor (let plot = 0; plot < maxPlots; plot++) {\n\t\tconst owner = api.getLobbyDbValue("plot" + plot)\n\t\tif (owner === me) {\n\t\t\treturn plot\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (owner === null && free === null) {\n\t\t\tfree = plot\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif (free !== null) {\n\t\tapi.setLobbyDbValue("plot" + free, me)\n\t\tclearPlot(free)\n\t}\n\treturn free\n}\n\n// The lowest corner of a plot, at its floor\nfunction plotCorner(plot) {\n\tconst step = CONFIG.plotSize + CONFIG.plotSpacing\n\tconst origin = CONFIG.plotOrigin.map(Math.floor)\n\treturn [origin[0] + (plot % CONFIG.plotsPerRow) * step, origin[1], origin[2] + Math.floor(plot / CONFIG.plotsPerRow) * step]\n}\n\nfunction goToPlot(playerId, plot) {\n\tconst corner = plotCorner(plot)\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, corner[0] + CONFIG.plotSize / 2, corner[1] + 1, corner[2] + 0.5)\n}\n\n// Lets a player build only inside their plot (none: nowhere): every other part of the plots, paths too, is boxed off\nfunction setBuildArea(playerId, plot) {\n\tfor (const rect of buildRects[playerId] || []) {\n\t\tapi.resetCanChangeBlockRect(playerId, rect[0], rect[1])\n\t}\n\tconst step = CONFIG.plotSize + CONFIG.plotSpacing\n\tconst low = plotCorner(0)\n\tconst high = [low[0] + CONFIG.plotsPerRow * step - 1, low[1] + plotHeight, low[2] + Math.ceil(maxPlots / CONFIG.plotsPerRow) * step - 1]\n\tlet rects = [[low, high]]\n\tif (plot !== null) {\n\t\tconst a = plotCorner(plot)\n\t\tconst b = [a[0] + CONFIG.plotSize - 1, high[1], a[2] + CONFIG.plotSize - 1]\n\t\trects = [\n\t\t\t[low, [a[0] - 1, high[1], high[2]]],\n\t\t\t[[b[0] + 1, low[1], low[2]], high],\n\t\t\t[[a[0], low[1], low[2]], [b[0], high[1], a[2] - 1]],\n\t\t\t[[a[0], low[1], b[2] + 1], [b[0], high[1], high[2]]],\n\t\t].filter((rect) => rect[0][0] <= rect[1][0] && rect[0][2] <= rect[1][2])\n\t}\n\tbuildRects[playerId] = rects\n\tfor (const rect of rects) {\n\t\tapi.setCantChangeBlockRect(playerId, rect[0].slice(), rect[1].slice())\n\t}\n}\n\n// Empties a plot and lays its floor, a few layers a tick, once its part of the world has loaded\nfunction clearPlot(plot) {\n\tclearQueue.push({ plot: plot, layer: 0 })\n}\n\nfunction clearSomeLayers() {\n\tconst job = clearQueue[0]\n\tconst a = plotCorner(job.plot)\n\tconst b = [a[0] + CONFIG.plotSize - 1, a[1], a[2] + CONFIG.plotSize - 1]\n\tfor (let i = 0; i < 8 && job.layer <= plotHeight; i++) {\n\t\tconst y = a[1] + job.layer\n\t\tif ([api.getBlock(a[0], y, a[2]), api.getBlock(b[0], y, b[2]), api.getBlock(a[0], y, b[2]), api.getBlock(b[0], y, a[2])].includes("Unloaded")) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor (let z = a[2]; z <= b[2]; z++) {\n\t\t\tapi.setBlockRect([a[0], y, z], [b[0], y, z], job.layer === 0 ? floorBlock : "Air")\n\t\t}\n\t\tjob.layer++\n\t}\n\tif (job.layer > plotHeight) {\n\t\tclearQueue.shift()\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tif (clearQueue.length > 0) {\n\t\tclearSomeLayers()\n\t}\n\tconst count = api.getPlayerIds().length\n\tif (CONFIG.mode === "battle" && phase === "waiting" && count >= CONFIG.minPlayers) {\n\t\tphase = "countdown"\n\t\tstartCountdown(battleCountdown, startBuilding)\n\t} else if (phase === "countdown" && count < CONFIG.minPlayers) {\n\t\tcancelCountdown()\n\t\tphase = "waiting"\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction startBuilding() {\n\tphase = "building"\n\tconst theme = pickRandom(CONFIG.themes) || "anything you like"\n\tbuilders = shuffleList(api.getPlayerIds())\n\tratings = {}\n\tbuilders.forEach((playerId, plot) => {\n\t\tplotOf[playerId] = plot\n\t\tratings[playerId] = {}\n\t\tclearPlot(plot)\n\t\tsetBuildArea(playerId, plot)\n\t\tgoToPlot(playerId, plot)\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Theme", theme)\n\t})\n\tannounce("Build a " + theme + "! You have " + CONFIG.buildSeconds + " seconds.", "aqua")\n\tphaseTimer = runLater(CONFIG.buildSeconds, startVoting)\n}\n\nfunction startVoting() {\n\tphase = "voting"\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tsetBuildArea(playerId, null)\n\t}\n\ttour = builders.slice()\n\tshowNextBuild()\n}\n\n// Takes everyone to the next builder\'s plot to rate it; after the last one, the best rated build wins\nfunction showNextBuild() {\n\tcancelTimer(phaseTimer)\n\ttour = tour.filter((playerId) => plotOf[playerId] !== undefined)\n\tshowing = tour.shift() || null\n\tif (showing === null) {\n\t\tfinishBattle()\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tgoToPlot(playerId, plotOf[showing])\n\t}\n\tannounce("Rate " + api.getEntityName(showing) + "\'s build! Type 1 to 5 in chat.", "yellow")\n\tphaseTimer = runLater(CONFIG.voteSeconds, showNextBuild)\n}\n\nfunction averageRating(playerId) {\n\tconst stars = Object.values(ratings[playerId] || {})\n\treturn stars.length === 0 ? 0 : stars.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0) / stars.length\n}\n\nfunction finishBattle() {\n\tconst left = builders.filter((playerId) => plotOf[playerId] !== undefined)\n\tconst best = left.reduce((top, playerId) => (top === null || averageRating(playerId) > averageRating(top) ? playerId : top), null)\n\tif (best !== null && averageRating(best) > 0) {\n\t\twinBattle(best, averageRating(best))\n\t} else {\n\t\tannounce("Nobody got any votes this time!", "gold")\n\t}\n\tphase = "break"\n\tshowing = null\n\tphaseTimer = runLater(battleCountdown, () => {\n\t\tphase = "waiting"\n\t})\n}\n\nfunction winBattle(playerId, stars) {\n\tconst wins = addSaved(playerId, "buildBattleWins", 1)\n\tannounce(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " wins with " + stars.toFixed(1) + " stars! (" + wins + " wins)", "gold")\n}\n\n// A rating of 1 to 5 for the build on show; false when it isn\'t one\nfunction rate(playerId, text) {\n\tconst stars = Number(text)\n\tif (phase !== "voting" || showing === null || !Number.isInteger(stars) || stars < 1 || stars > 5) {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif (playerId === showing) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You can\'t rate your own build!", { color: "red" })\n\t} else {\n\t\tratings[showing][playerId] = stars\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You gave it " + stars + " stars!", { color: "lime" })\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerChat(playerId, chatMessage) {\n\tif (rate(playerId, chatMessage.trim())) {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction playerCommand(playerId, command) {\n\tconst words = command.trim().toLowerCase().split(" ")\n\tif (words[0] === "plot" || words[0] === "home") {\n\t\tif (plotOf[playerId] === undefined || (CONFIG.mode === "battle" && phase !== "building")) {\n\t\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You don\'t have a plot right now.", { color: "red" })\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tgoToPlot(playerId, plotOf[playerId])\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tif ((words[0] === "vote" || words[0] === "rate") && phase === "voting") {\n\t\tif (!rate(playerId, words[1] || "")) {\n\t\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Type a number from 1 to 5, like /vote 4", { color: "red" })\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\t// Returns nothing for other commands: any value, false too, stops the game\'s own commands (/spawn) running\n\treturn\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerLeave(playerId) {\n\tdelete plotOf[playerId]\n\tdelete buildRects[playerId]\n\tif (showing === playerId) {\n\t\tshowNextBuild()\n\t}\n\trunLater(0, () => {\n\t\tconst left = builders.filter((id) => plotOf[id] !== undefined)\n\t\tif (phase === "building" && left.length < 2) {\n\t\t\tcancelTimer(phaseTimer)\n\t\t\tannounce("Not enough builders left, so the battle is over.", "yellow")\n\t\t\tfinishBattle()\n\t\t}\n\t})\n}',

+        code: '// Murder Mystery: each round one player is secretly the murderer, with a sword that kills in one hit, and one is the\n// sheriff, with a bow. Everyone else is innocent. The innocents win if the murderer dies or time runs out; the murderer\n// wins when everyone else is dead. A sheriff who kills an innocent dies too.\nconst roles = {}\nlet murdererId = null\nlet murdererName = ""\nlet sheriffId = null\nlet winner = null\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tif (isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\teliminate(playerId)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "A round is on: watch this one, you\'ll play in the next!", { color: "yellow" })\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tapi.setPlayerGamemode(playerId, "survival")\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, CONFIG.spawnPosition[0], CONFIG.spawnPosition[1], CONFIG.spawnPosition[2])\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Welcome to Murder Mystery! Find the murderer before they find you.", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\nfunction beginRound() {\n\tbringEveryoneBack()\n\tconst players = shuffleList(api.getPlayerIds())\n\tmurdererId = players[0]\n\tmurdererName = api.getEntityName(murdererId)\n\tsheriffId = players.length > 1 ? players[1] : null\n\twinner = null\n\tfor (const playerId of players) {\n\t\troles[playerId] = playerId === murdererId ? "Murderer" : playerId === sheriffId ? "Sheriff" : "Innocent"\n\t\tconst spot = randomSpot(CONFIG.spawnPosition, CONFIG.spreadRadius)\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.forceRespawn(playerId, spot)\n\t\t}\n\t\tapi.setPosition(playerId, spot[0], spot[1], spot[2])\n\t\thealFully(playerId)\n\t\tgiveRoleItems(playerId)\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Role", roles[playerId])\n\t}\n}\n\n// Gives each role its items and tells the player their role, only them\nfunction giveRoleItems(playerId) {\n\tif (roles[playerId] === "Murderer") {\n\t\tgiveKit(playerId, [[CONFIG.murdererWeapon, 1]])\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You are the MURDERER! Watch the rest of the round.", { color: "yellow" })\n\t}\n\tcheckWin()\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerDamagingOtherPlayer(attackingPlayer, damagedPlayer) {\n\tif (seeking && isRoundRunning() && seekers[attackingPlayer] && !seekers[damagedPlayer] && !found[damagedPlayer]) {\n\t\tfindHider(damagedPlayer, attackingPlayer)\n\t}\n\treturn "preventDamage"\n}\n\nfunction checkWin() {\n\tif (!isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst players = api.getPlayerIds()\n\tif (players.length < 2) {\n\t\tendRound("Not enough players left.")\n\t} else if (!players.some((playerId) => seekers[playerId])) {\n\t\tendRound("All the seekers left!")\n\t} else if (hidersLeft().length === 0) {\n\t\tseekersWon = true\n\t\tendRound("Everyone was found! Still hidden: " + hiders.map((playerId) => api.getEntityName(playerId)).join(", "), "lime")\n\tfor (const playerId of hiders) {\n\t\tif (CONFIG.winCoins > 0) {\n\t\t\taddCoins(playerId, CONFIG.winCoins)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction finishRound() {\n\tcancelCountdown()\n\tconst hiders = hidersLeft()\n\tif (!seekersWon && hiders.length > 0 && api.getPlayerIds().length >= 2) {\n\t\trewardHiders(hiders)\n\t}\n\tfor (const playerId of Object.keys(seekers)) {\n\t\tif (!seeking) {\n\t\t\t// The round ended in hiding time: out of the box\n\t\t\tgoTo(playerId, CONFIG.startPosition)\n\t\t}\n\t\tdelete seekers[playerId]\n\t}\n\tif (Object.keys(found).length > 0) {\n\t\tbringEveryoneBack()\n\t}\n\tfor (const playerId of Object.keys(found)) {\n\t\tdelete found[playerId]\n\t}\n\tseeking = false\n}\n\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tconst players = api.getPlayerIds()\n\tif (isRoundRunning() && !seeking) {\n\t\t// Hiding time: seekers who wander from their box are put back\n\t\tfor (const playerId of players) {\n\t\t\tconst spot = CONFIG.seekerWaitPosition\n\t\t\tconst position = api.getPosition(playerId)\n\t\t\tif (seekers[playerId] && Math.abs(position[0] - spot[0]) + Math.abs(position[2] - spot[2]) > 3) {\n\t\t\t\tgoTo(playerId, spot)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tconst shown = players.length + " " + isRoundRunning() + " " + seeking + " " + roundSecondsLeft() + " " + hidersLeft().length + " " + Object.keys(seekers).length\n\tif (shown === lastShown) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tlastShown = shown\n\tfor (const playerId of players) {\n\t\tconst role = !isRoundRunning() ? Walk into the gold keys to pick them up for the team. With enough keys the\n// exit opens: reach it to escape. A monster\'s touch catches you, and you watch the rest of the round.\nconst keyBlock = "Block of Gold" // what a key looks like\nconst gateBlock = "Black Glass" // closes the exit until the keys are found\nconst headStartSeconds = 5 // seconds players get to run before the monsters come in\nconst monsters = {} // the monsters chasing this round, by mob id\nconst escaped = {} // the players who escaped this round\nlet keysTaken = []\nlet keysFound = 0\nlet exitOpen = false\nlet roundNumber = 0\nlet chaseTimer = null\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tif (CONFIG.darkness) {\n\t\tmakeDark(playerId)\n\t}\n\tshowKeys(playerId)\n\tsendToStart(playerId)\n\tif (isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\teliminate(playerId)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "A chase is on! Watch this one, you\'ll play in the next.", { color: "yellow" })\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Find the keys, open the exit and escape the monster!", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\nfunction makeDark(playerId) {\n\tapi.setClientOptions(playerId, {\n\t\tlightingOverride: true,\n\t\tskyLightColourOverride: "#1c1a26",\n\t\tambientLightColourOverride: "#0c0b12",\n\t\tfogColourOverride: "#060609",\n\t})\n}\n\nfunction sendToStart(playerId) {\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, CONFIG.startPosition[0], CONFIG.startPosition[1], CONFIG.startPosition[2])\n}\n\nfunction keysToOpen() {\n\tconst all = CONFIG.keyPositions.length\n\treturn CONFIG.keysNeeded > 0 ? Math.min(CONFIG.keysNeeded, all) : all\n}\n\nfunction showKeys(playerId) {\n\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Keys", keysFound + "/" + keysToOpen())\n\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Exit", exitOpen ? "open!" : "locked")\n}\n\n// Whether a player is at a block\'s spot [x, y, z]: in it, beside it or on it\nfunction isAt(playerId, spot) {\n\tconst position = api.getPosition(playerId)\n\tconst x = Math.floor(spot[0]) + 0.5\n\tconst z = Math.floor(spot[2]) + 0.5\n\treturn Math.abs(position[0] - x) < 1.6 && Math.abs(position[2] - z) < 1.6 && position[1] > spot[1] - 1.5 && position[1] < spot[1] + 2\n}\n\n// Puts a block at a spot once that part of the world has loaded, unless a new round has started since\nfunction placeBlock(spot, blockName) {\n\tconst round = roundNumber\n\twhenWorldLoaded(spot, () => {\n\t\tif (round === roundNumber) {\n\t\t\tapi.setBlock(Math.floor(spot[0]), Math.floor(spot[1]), Math.floor(spot[2]), blockName)\n\t\t}\n\t})\n}\n\nfunction setExit(blockName) {\n\tplaceBlock(CONFIG.exitPosition, blockName)\n\tplaceBlock([CONFIG.exitPosition[0], CONFIG.exitPosition[1] + 1, CONFIG.exitPosition[2]], blockName)\n}\n\nfunction beginRound() {\n\troundNumber++\n\tkeysTaken = CONFIG.keyPositions.map(() => false)\n\tkeysFound = 0\n\texitOpen = false\n\tfor (const playerId in escaped) {\n\t\tdelete escaped[playerId]\n\t}\n\tCONFIG.keyPositions.forEach((spot) => placeBlock(spot, keyBlock))\n\tsetExit(gateBlock)\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.forceRespawn(playerId, CONFIG.startPosition)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsendToStart(playerId)\n\t\thealFully(playerId)\n\t\tshowKeys(playerId)\n\t}\n\tif (keysToOpen() === 0) {\n\t\topenExit()\n\t}\n\tannounce("Run! The monster comes in " + headStartSeconds + " seconds!", "red")\n\tconst round = roundNumber\n\trunLater(headStartSeconds, () => {\n\t\tif (round === roundNumber && isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\t\treleaseMonsters()\n\t\t}\n\t})\n}\n\nfunction releaseMonsters() {\n\tconst ids = spawnMobs(CONFIG.monsterType, CONFIG.monsterCount, CONFIG.startPosition, 1)\n\tif (ids.length === 0) {\n\t\tannounce("No monster could come in! Turn on mobs in your world settings.", "red")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor (const mobId of ids) {\n\t\tmonsters[mobId] = true\n\t\tapi.setMobSetting(mobId, "walkingSpeedMultiplier", CONFIG.monsterSpeed)\n\t\tapi.setMobSetting(mobId, "runningSpeedMultiplier", CONFIG.monsterSpeed)\n\t}\n\tannounce("The monster is coming!", "red")\n\tchaseNearest()\n\tchaseTimer = repeatEvery(1, chaseNearest)\n}\n\n// Every second each monster goes after the player nearest to it who is still in\nfunction chaseNearest() {\n\tconst targets = playersLeft().filter((playerId) => api.isAlive(playerId))\n\tfor (const mobId of Object.keys(monsters)) {\n\t\tconst at = api.getPosition(mobId)\n\t\tlet nearest = null\n\t\tlet nearestDistance = Infinity\n\t\tfor (const playerId of targets) {\n\t\t\tconst position = api.getPosition(playerId)\n\t\t\tconst distance = Math.hypot(position[0] - at[0], position[1] - at[1], position[2] - at[2])\n\t\t\tif (distance < nearestDistance) {\n\t\t\t\tnearest = playerId\n\t\t\t\tnearestDistance = distance\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tconst now = api.getMobAiState(mobId)\n\t\tif (nearest !== null && !(now.state === "chasing" && now.params && now.params.targetId === nearest)) {\n\t\t\tapi.setMobAiState(mobId, "chasing", { targetId: nearest }, { hold: true })\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction openExit() {\n\texitOpen = true\n\tsetExit("Air")\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tshowKeys(playerId)\n\t}\n\tannounce("The exit is open! Run to it!", "lime")\n}\n\nfunction takeKey(playerId, index) {\n\tkeysTaken[index] = true\n\tkeysFound++\n\tconst spot = CONFIG.keyPositions[index]\n\tapi.setBlock(Math.floor(spot[0]), Math.floor(spot[1]), Math.floor(spot[2]), "Air")\n\tapi.broadcastMessage(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " found a key! " + keysFound + "/" + keysToOpen(), { color: "yellow" })\n\tfor (const id of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tshowKeys(id)\n\t}\n\tif (!exitOpen && keysFound >= keysToOpen()) {\n\t\topenExit()\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction escapePlayer(playerId) {\n\tescaped[playerId] = true\n\teliminate(playerId)\n\trewardEscape(playerId)\n\tcheckForEnd()\n}\n\nfunction rewardEscape(playerId) {\n\taddCoins(playerId, CONFIG.winCoins)\n\tannounce(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " escaped! +" + CONFIG.winCoins + " coins", "lime")\n}\n\nfunction catchPlayer(playerId) {\n\teliminate(playerId)\n\tapi.broadcastMessage(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " was caught by the monster!", { color: "red" })\n\tcheckForEnd()\n}\n\nfunction checkForEnd() {\n\tif (!isRoundRunning() || playersLeft().length > 0) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst names = Object.keys(escaped).filter((playerId) => api.getPlayerIds().includes(playerId)).map((playerId) => api.getEntityName(playerId))\n\tendRound(names.length > 0 ? names.join(", ") + " escaped the monster!" : "The monster caught everyone!")\n}\n\nfunction finishRound() {\n\tcancelTimer(chaseTimer)\n\tchaseTimer = null\n\tremoveAllMobs()\n\tfor (const mobId in monsters) {\n\t\tdelete monsters[mobId]\n\t}\n\tbringEveryoneBack()\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.forceRespawn(playerId, CONFIG.startPosition)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsendToStart(playerId)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tfor (const playerId of playersLeft()) {\n\t\t// A catch or an escape can end the round: stop then\n\t\tif (!isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tcatchPlayer(playerId)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tCONFIG.keyPositions.forEach((spot, index) => {\n\t\t\tif (!keysTaken[index] && isAt(playerId, spot)) {\n\t\t\t\ttakeKey(playerId, index)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t\tif (exitOpen && isAt(playerId, CONFIG.exitPosition)) {\n\t\t\tescapePlayer(playerId)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// A monster\'s touch catches a player at once\nfunction onMobDamagingPlayer(attackingMob, damagedPlayer) {\n\tif (monsters[attackingMob]) {\n\t\treturn 1000\n\t}\n}\n\n// Monsters can\'t be hurt, and the world doesn\'t take them away\nfunction onPlayerDamagingMob(playerId, mobId) {\n\tif (monsters[mobId]) {\n\t\treturn "preventDamage"\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onWorldAttemptDespawnMob(mobId) {\n\tif (monsters[mobId]) {\n\t\treturn "preventDespawn"\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onMobDespawned(mobId) {\n\tdelete monsters[mobId]\n}\n\nfunction onRespawnRequest(playerId) {\n\tif (isRoundRunning() && playersLeft().includes(playerId)) {\n\t\tcatchPlayer(playerId)\n\t}\n\treturn CONFIG.startPosition\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerLeave(playerId) {\n\tdelete escaped[playerId]\n\trunLater(0, checkForEnd)\n}',

+        code: '// Last one standing: players wait in the lobby, then a round sends everyone to the arena with a kit. Falling below\n// fallY or dying knocks you out and you watch the rest. The last player left wins. With disappearingFloor, the floor\n// vanishes a moment after you step on it, so keep moving!\nconst vanishingBlocks = {}\nlet roundPlayerCount = 0\nlet floorReady = false\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tif (!floorReady) {\n\t\tfloorReady = true\n\t\tbuildFloor()\n\t\twhenFallBelow(Math.min(CONFIG.fallY, CONFIG.arenaPosition[1] - 3), fellOut)\n\t\tif (CONFIG.spleef) {\n\t\t\twhenItemUsed(CONFIG.spleefTool, breakFloorBlock, 0.15)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif (isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\teliminate(playerId)\n\t\tsendToWatch(playerId)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "A round is on! Be the last one standing!", "lime")\n}\n\nfunction finishRound() {\n\tbringEveryoneBack()\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tapi.clearInventory(playerId)\n\t\tapi.setPosition(playerId, CONFIG.lobbyPosition[0], CONFIG.lobbyPosition[1], CONFIG.lobbyPosition[2])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction knockOut(playerId, why) {\n\tif (!isRoundRunning() || !playersLeft().includes(playerId)) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\teliminate(playerId)\n\tapi.broadcastMessage(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " " + why, { color: "red" })\n\tcheckForWinner()\n}\n\nfunction checkForWinner() {\n\tif (!isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst left = playersLeft()\n\tif (left.length === 1 && roundPlayerCount > 1) {\n\t\twinRound(left[0])\n\t} else if (left.length === 0) {\n\t\tendRound("Nobody is left standing! It\'s a draw.")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction winRound(playerId) {\n\tconst wins = addSaved(playerId, "lastStandingWins", 1)\n\tendRound(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " is the last one standing! (" + wins + " wins)")\n}\n\n// The floor blocks under a player\'s feet vanish a moment later\nfunction crumbleUnder(position) {\n\tfor (const dx of [-0.3, 0.3]) {\n\t\tfor (const dz of [-0.3, 0.3]) {\n\t\t\tconst x = Math.floor(position[0] + dx)\n\t\t\tconst z = Math.floor(position[2] + dz)\n\t\t\tconst y = Math.floor(position[1] - 0.5)\n\t\t\tconst key = x + "," + z\n\t\t\tif (y !== floorY() || vanishingBlocks[key] || api.getBlock(x, y, z) !== CONFIG.floorBlock) {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tvanishingBlocks[key] = true\n\t\t\trunLater(0.5, () => {\n\t\t\t\tdelete vanishingBlocks[key]\n\t\t\t\tif (isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\t\t\t\tapi.setBlock(x, y, z, "Air")\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Spleef: a floor block clicked with the spleefTool, from close by, breaks at once\nfunction breakFloorBlock(playerId, x, y, z) {\n\tif (x === undefined || !isRoundRunning() || !playersLeft().includes(playerId) || y !== floorY() || api.getBlock(x, y, z) !== CONFIG.floorBlock) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst position = api.getPosition(playerId)\n\tif (Math.abs(position[0] - x) <= 6 && Math.abs(position[2] - z) <= 6) {\n\t\tapi.setBlock(x, y, z, "Air")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction fellOut(playerId) {\n\tif (isRoundRunning() && playersLeft().includes(playerId)) {\n\t\t// Watch from above, unless the round ends now and sends everyone to the lobby\n\t\tsendToWatch(playerId)\n\t\tknockOut(playerId, "fell out!")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tif (!CONFIG.disappearingFloor || CONFIG.spleef) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor (const playerId of playersLeft()) {\n\t\tif (!isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tcrumbleUnder(api.getPosition(playerId))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onAttemptKillPlayer(killedPlayer) {\n\tknockOut(killedPlayer, "was knocked out!")\n}\n\nfunction onRespawnRequest(playerId) {\n\tknockOut(playerId, "was knocked out!")\n\treturn isRoundRunning() ? [CONFIG.arenaPosition[0], CONFIG.arenaPosition[1] + 8, CONFIG.arenaPosition[2]] : CONFIG.lobbyPosition\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerLeave(playerId) {\n\trunLater(0, checkForWinner)\n}',

+        code: '// Survive the disasters: each round sends everyone into the arena, then disasters hit: rising lava, TNT rain,\n// meteors, falling blocks or a floor that breaks away. Dying or falling out puts you out to watch. The last player\n// left wins, or everyone still alive when the time runs out. +        code: '// Football: two teams, one ball. Hit the ball to kick it where you look, run into it to dribble. Put it in the other\n// team\'s goal to score. First team to CONFIG.goalsToWin goals wins, or the most goals when time runs out.\nconst goals = {}\nconst armourColours = ["White", "Orange", "Magenta", "Light Blue", "Yellow", "Lime", "Pink", "Gray", "Light Gray", "Cyan", "Purple", "Blue", "Brown", "Green", "Red", "Black"]\nlet ball = null\nlet lastToucher = null\nlet kickoffMs = 0 // the ball waits in the middle until this runs out\nlet roundWinner = null\nlet pitchBuilt = false\nlet shownSeconds = -1\n\n// The pitch in blocks: its edges, the height players stand at, and the goal mouth (z from goalMinZ to goalMaxZ)\nfunction pitch() {\n\tconst length = Math.max(12, CONFIG.pitchLength)\n\tconst width = Math.max(8, CONFIG.pitchWidth)\n\tconst midX = Math.floor(CONFIG.pitchCentre[0])\n\tconst midZ = Math.floor(CONFIG.pitchCentre[2])\n\tconst half = Math.min(4, Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 6)))\n\tconst minX = midX - Math.floor(length / 2)\n\tconst minZ = midZ - Math.floor(width / 2)\n\treturn { minX: minX, maxX: minX + length - 1, minZ: minZ, maxZ: minZ + width - 1, y: Math.floor(CONFIG.pitchCentre[1]), midX: midX, midZ: midZ, goalMinZ: midZ - half, goalMaxZ: midZ + half }\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tbuildPitch()\n\tjoinSmallestTeam(playerId)\n\tsendToSpawn(playerId)\n\tshowScore()\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Kick the ball into the other goal! First to " + CONFIG.goalsToWin + " goals wins.", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\nfunction teamSpawn(playerId) {\n\tconst p = pitch()\n\tconst side = CONFIG.teamNames.indexOf(getTeam(playerId)) === 0 ? -1 : 1\n\treturn randomSpot([p.midX + side * Math.floor((p.maxX - p.minX) / 4), p.y, p.midZ], 3)\n}\n\nfunction sendToSpawn(playerId) {\n\tconst spot = teamSpawn(playerId)\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, spot[0], spot[1], spot[2])\n\thealFully(playerId)\n\tconst team = getTeam(playerId)\n\tif (armourColours.includes(team)) {\n\t\tapi.setItemSlot(playerId, 46, team + " Wood Helmet")\n\t\tapi.setItemSlot(playerId, 47, team + " Wood Chestplate")\n\t}\n}\n\n// Grass, a glass wall round the pitch, and a goal behind each end line (glass net, white crossbar)\nfunction buildPitch() {\n\tif (pitchBuilt || !CONFIG.buildPitch) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tpitchBuilt = true\n\tconst p = pitch()\n\tconst top = p.y + 3\n\tfillBox([p.minX - 4, p.y - 1, p.minZ - 1], [p.maxX + 4, p.y - 1, p.maxZ + 1], "Grass Block")\n\tfillBox([p.minX, p.y, p.minZ], [p.maxX, top, p.maxZ], "Air")\n\tfillBox([p.minX - 4, p.y, p.minZ - 1], [p.maxX + 4, top, p.minZ - 1], "Glass")\n\tfillBox([p.minX - 4, p.y, p.maxZ + 1], [p.maxX + 4, top, p.maxZ + 1], "Glass")\n\tfor (const end of [-1, 1]) {\n\t\tconst near = end < 0 ? +        code: '// Cops and robbers: robbers sneak to the vault, stay next to it to grab loot, and bring the loot back to their hideout\n// to bank it. A cop\'s hit sends a robber to jail and their loot is lost; a free robber standing on the jail button\n// breaks everyone out. The robbers win by banking CONFIG.lootToWin; the cops win by jailing every robber at once, or\n// when the time runs out.\nconst roles = {} // each player\'s role this round: "Cop" or "Robber"\nconst carried = {} // the loot each robber carries\nconst grabbing = {} // how long each robber has stood at the vault, in ms\nconst jailed = {} // the robbers in jail\nlet banked = 0\nlet roundWinner = null\nlet jailProtected = false\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tif (!jailProtected) {\n\t\tjailProtected = true\n\t\t// Nobody can break into or out of the jail: its walls, floor and roof are one block around its inside\n\t\tconst box = jailBox()\n\t\tprotectArea([box.x1 - 1, box.y1 - 1, box.z1 - 1], [box.x2 + 1, box.y2 + 1, box.z2 + 1])\n\t}\n\tif (isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\tsetRole(playerId, "Robber")\n\t\tsendToStart(playerId)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "A round is on! You\'re a robber: grab loot at the vault and bring it to the hideout.", { color: "aqua" })\n\t} else {\n\t\tgoTo(playerId, CONFIG.hideoutPosition)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Cops and robbers starts soon! Robbers steal loot, cops send them to jail.", { color: "aqua" })\n\t}\n\tupdateSidebars()\n}\n\nfunction goTo(playerId, spot) {\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, spot[0], spot[1], spot[2])\n}\n\n// The inside of the jail: x1..x2, y1..y2, z1..z2\nfunction jailBox() {\n\tconst a = CONFIG.jailCorner1.map(Math.floor)\n\tconst b = CONFIG.jailCorner2.map(Math.floor)\n\treturn { x1: Math.min(a[0], b[0]), x2: Math.max(a[0], b[0]), y1: Math.min(a[1], b[1]), y2: Math.max(a[1], b[1]), z1: Math.min(a[2], b[2]), z2: Math.max(a[2], b[2]) }\n}\n\nfunction jailSpot() {\n\tconst box = jailBox()\n\treturn [(box.x1 + box.x2 + 1) / 2, box.y1, (box.z1 + box.z2 + 1) / 2]\n}\n\n// Whether a player stands within reach blocks of a spot [x, y, z]\nfunction isNear(playerId, spot, reach) {\n\tconst position = api.getPosition(playerId)\n\treturn Math.hypot(position[0] - spot[0] - 0.5, position[2] - spot[2] - 0.5) <= reach && Math.abs(position[1] - spot[1]) <= 2.5\n}\n\nfunction withRole(role) {\n\treturn api.getPlayerIds().filter((playerId) => roles[playerId] === role)\n}\n\nfunction setRole(playerId, role) {\n\troles[playerId] = role\n\tcarried[playerId] = 0\n\tdelete grabbing[playerId]\n\tdelete jailed[playerId]\n\tgiveKit(playerId, role === "Cop" ? CONFIG.copKit : CONFIG.robberKit)\n\thealFully(playerId)\n}\n\nfunction sendToStart(playerId) {\n\tgoTo(playerId, roles[playerId] === "Cop" ? CONFIG.vaultPosition : CONFIG.hideoutPosition)\n}\n\nfunction updateSidebars() {\n\tconst inJail = Object.keys(jailed).length\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Team", roles[playerId] ? roles[playerId] + "s" : "waiting")\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Loot banked", banked + "/" + CONFIG.lootToWin)\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "In jail", inJail)\n\t\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Your loot", roles[playerId] === "Robber" ? carried[playerId] || 0 : "-")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction beginRound() {\n\tbanked = 0\n\troundWinner = null\n\tconst players = shuffleList(api.getPlayerIds())\n\tconst cops = Math.max(1, Math.min(CONFIG.copCount, players.length - 1))\n\tplayers.forEach((playerId, index) => {\n\t\tconst role = index < cops ? "Cop" : "Robber"\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.forceRespawn(playerId, role === "Cop" ? CONFIG.vaultPosition : CONFIG.hideoutPosition)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsetRole(playerId, role)\n\t\tsendToStart(playerId)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, role === "Cop" ? "You\'re a cop! Hit robbers to send them to jail." : "You\'re a robber! Grab loot at the vault and bring it to the hideout.", { color: role === "Cop" ? "blue" : "orange" })\n\t})\n\tupdateSidebars()\n\tannounce("Cops and robbers! Robbers, grab the loot. Cops, catch them!", "aqua")\n}\n\nfunction finishRound() {\n\tif (roundWinner === null) {\n\t\tannounce("The robbers ran out of time! " + rewardWinners("Cop"), "gold")\n\t}\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tdelete roles[playerId]\n\t\tdelete jailed[playerId]\n\t\tcarried[playerId] = 0\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.forceRespawn(playerId, CONFIG.hideoutPosition)\n\t\t}\n\t\tgoTo(playerId, CONFIG.hideoutPosition)\n\t}\n\tupdateSidebars()\n}\n\n// What the winning team gets: lootCoins coins each. " + banked + "/" + CONFIG.lootToWin, { color: "yellow" })\n\tupdateSidebars()\n\tif (banked >= CONFIG.lootToWin) {\n\t\tteamWins("Robber", "The robbers got away with the loot!")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction checkForEnd() {\n\tif (!isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst robbers = withRole("Robber")\n\tif (robbers.length === 0) {\n\t\tteamWins("Cop", "There are no robbers left!")\n\t} else if (robbers.every((playerId) => jailed[playerId])) {\n\t\tteamWins("Cop", "Every robber is in jail!")\n\t} else if (withRole("Cop").length === 0) {\n\t\tteamWins("Robber", "There are no cops left!")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tfor (const playerId of withRole("Robber")) {\n\t\t// A bank or a jailing can end the round: stop then\n\t\tif (!isRoundRunning()) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (jailed[playerId] || !api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (isNear(playerId, CONFIG.vaultPosition, 3)) {\n\t\t\tif (!grabbing[playerId]) {\n\t\t\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Grabbing the loot... stay here for " + CONFIG.lootSeconds + " seconds!", { color: "yellow" })\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tgrabbing[playerId] = (grabbing[playerId] || 0) + ms\n\t\t\tif (grabbing[playerId] >= CONFIG.lootSeconds * 1000) {\n\t\t\t\t// Staying grabs again; 1, not 0, so "Grabbing the loot" isn\'t said again\n\t\t\t\tgrabbing[playerId] = 1\n\t\t\t\tcarried[playerId] += CONFIG.lootCoins\n\t\t\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You grabbed " + CONFIG.lootCoins + " loot! Bring it to the hideout.", { color: "lime" })\n\t\t\t\tupdateSidebars()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tdelete grabbing[playerId]\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (carried[playerId] > 0 && isNear(playerId, CONFIG.hideoutPosition, 3)) {\n\t\t\tbankLoot(playerId)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (Object.keys(jailed).length > 0 && isNear(playerId, CONFIG.jailButton, 1.5)) {\n\t\t\tbreakOut(playerId)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Nobody gets hurt by other players: a cop\'s hit on a free robber sends them to jail instead\nfunction onPlayerDamagingOtherPlayer(attackingPlayer, damagedPlayer) {\n\tif (isRoundRunning() && roles[attackingPlayer] === "Cop" && roles[damagedPlayer] === "Robber" && !jailed[damagedPlayer]) {\n\t\tsendToJail(damagedPlayer, attackingPlayer)\n\t}\n\treturn "preventDamage"\n}\n\n// A robber who dies loses the loot they carried\nfunction onRespawnRequest(playerId) {\n\tif (roles[playerId] === "Robber" && carried[playerId] > 0) {\n\t\tcarried[playerId] = 0\n\t\tupdateSidebars()\n\t}\n\tif (jailed[playerId]) {\n\t\treturn jailSpot()\n\t}\n\treturn roles[playerId] === "Cop" ? CONFIG.vaultPosition : CONFIG.hideoutPosition\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerLeave(playerId) {\n\tdelete roles[playerId]\n\tdelete carried[playerId]\n\tdelete grabbing[playerId]\n\tdelete jailed[playerId]\n\trunLater(0, () => {\n\t\tupdateSidebars()\n\t\tcheckForEnd()\n\t})\n}',

Cross to the gold to win\nfunction buildBridge() {\n\tconst a = arena()\n\tbadLane = []\n\tbrokenPanels = {}\n\tfillBox([a.cx - 3, a.fy, a.z1], [a.cx + 1, a.fy, a.z1 + 1], "Smooth Stone")\n\tfillBox([a.cx - 3, a.fy, a.z2 - 1], [a.cx + 1, a.fy, a.z2], "Block of Gold")\n\tfor (let pair = 0; pair < a.r - 2; pair++) {\n\t\tconst z = a.z1 + 2 + pair * 2\n\t\tbadLane.push(randomInt(0, 1))\n\t\tfillBox([a.cx - 3, a.fy, z], [a.cx - 2, a.fy, z + 1], "Glass")\n\t\tfillBox([a.cx, a.fy, z], [a.cx + 1, a.fy, z + 1], "Glass")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction startBridge() {}\n\nfunction stepBridge(playerId, position) {\n\tconst a = arena()\n\tif (Math.abs(position[1] - (a.fy + 1)) > 0.6 || finishers.includes(playerId)) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst x = Math.floor(position[0])\n\tconst z = Math.floor(position[2])\n\tconst lane = x === a.cx - 3 || x === a.cx - 2 ? 0 : x === a.cx || x === a.cx + 1 ? 1 : -1\n\tconst pair = Math.floor((z - a.z1 - 2) / 2)\n\tif (z >= a.z2 - 1 && x >= a.cx - 3 && x <= a.cx + 1) {\n\t\tfinishers.push(playerId)\n\t\tannounce(api.getEntityName(playerId) + " crossed the bridge!", "lime")\n\t\tcheckForWinner()\n\t} else if (lane >= 0 && pair >= 0 && pair < badLane.length && badLane[pair] === lane && !brokenPanels[lane + "," + pair]) {\n\t\tbrokenPanels[lane + "," + pair] = true\n\t\tconst x1 = lane === 0 ? a.cx - 3 : a.cx\n\t\tconst z1 = a.z1 + 2 + pair * 2\n\t\trunLater(0.2, () => fillBox([x1, a.fy, z1], [x1 + 1, a.fy, z1 + 1], "Air"))\n\t}\n}\n\n// Spleef: break the floor under the others. Later, bits of floor vanish by themselves\nfunction buildSpleef() {\n\tconst a = arena()\n\tfillBox([a.x1, a.fy, a.z1], [a.x2, a.fy, a.z2], CONFIG.spleefBlock)\n}\n\nfunction startSpleef() {\n\tfor (const playerId of playersLeft()) {\n\t\tgiveKit(playerId, [["Diamond Spade", 1]])\n\t}\n\tlaterThisRound(25, () => {\n\t\tconst loop = repeatEvery(1.5, () => {\n\t\t\tconst a = arena()\n\t\t\tfor (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n\t\t\t\tapi.setBlock(randomInt(a.x1, a.x2), a.fy, randomInt(a.z1, a.z2), "Air")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t\ttimers.push(loop)\n\t})\n}\n\n// Musical chairs: when the music stops, one green block (chair) fewer than players appears; one player per chair\nfunction buildChairs() {\n\tconst a = arena()\n\tfillBox([a.x1, a.fy, a.z1], [a.x2, a.fy, a.z2], "Gray Wool")\n}\n\nfunction startChairs() {\n\tchairs = []\n\tclaims = {}\n\tchairsOpen = false\n\tconst a = arena()\n\tfillBox([a.x1, a.fy, a.z1], [a.x2, a.fy, a.z2], "Gray Wool")\n\tannounce("Music! +        code: '// Minigame lobby: players wait in the lobby, then vote with /vote for the next game, and everyone is sent to its area.\n// Falling CONFIG.fallDepth blocks below the game\'s spawn, or dying, knocks you out to watch. The last player in wins,\n// or everyone still in when the time runs out. Then everyone comes back to the lobby for the next vote.\nconst restSeconds = 5 // seconds in the lobby after a game, before the next vote\nlet phase = "waiting" // "waiting", "voting", "playing" or "resting"\nlet currentGame = null // the game being played: [name, spawnPosition, gameSeconds]\nlet gameNumber = 0\nlet startedWith = 0 // players in the game when it started\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tif (phase === "playing") {\n\t\teliminate(playerId)\n\t\tgoTo(playerId, currentGame[1])\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, currentGame[0] + " is on! Watch this one, then vote for the next game.", { color: "yellow" })\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tgoTo(playerId, CONFIG.lobbyPosition)\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Welcome to the lobby! We vote for a game once " + CONFIG.minPlayers + " players are here.", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\nfunction goTo(playerId, spot) {\n\tapi.setPosition(playerId, spot[0], spot[1], spot[2])\n}\n\nfunction startGameVote() {\n\tif (CONFIG.games.length === 1) {\n\t\tstartGame(CONFIG.games[0])\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tphase = "voting"\n\tstartVote(CONFIG.games.map((game) => game[0]), CONFIG.voteSeconds, (winner) => {\n\t\tif (api.getPlayerIds().length < CONFIG.minPlayers) {\n\t\t\tphase = "waiting"\n\t\t\tannounce("Waiting for more players...", "yellow")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tstartGame(CONFIG.games.find((game) => game[0] === winner))\n\t})\n}\n\nfunction startGame(game) {\n\tphase = "playing"\n\tcurrentGame = game\n\tgameNumber++\n\tstartedWith = api.getPlayerIds().length\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tif (!api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.forceRespawn(playerId, game[1])\n\t\t}\n\t\tgoTo(playerId, game[1])\n\t\thealFully(playerId)\n\t}\n\tannounce(game[0] + "! Don\'t fall: the last one in wins!", "aqua")\n\tconst number = gameNumber\n\trunLater(game[2] || 60, () => {\n\t\tif (number === gameNumber && phase === "playing") {\n\t\t\tendGame(playersLeft(), "Time\'s up! +        code: '// Shop: /shop lists what is for sale and opens the shop screen, /buy <number or name> buys it with coins.\n// With sellPrices set, /sell (and standing on sellPad) sells those items for coins.\nlet shopMade = false\nlet sellPadMs = 0\nconst onSellPad = {}\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tmakeShop()\n\tconst selling = sellList().length > 0 ? " + (entry[1] || 1) + " " + entry[0] + " - " + entry[2] + " coins")\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, CONFIG.shopTitle + " (you have " + getCoins(playerId) + " coins):\\n" + lines.join("\\n") + "\\nType /buy and a number, like /buy 1", { color: "yellow" })\n\tapi.openShop(playerId, false, "Shop", false)\n}\n\nfunction findShopItem(wanted) {\n\tconst number = Number(wanted)\n\tif (Number.isInteger(number) && number >= 1 && number <= CONFIG.shopItems.length) {\n\t\treturn CONFIG.shopItems[number - 1]\n\t}\n\tconst name = wanted.toLowerCase()\n\treturn CONFIG.shopItems.find((entry) => entry[0].toLowerCase() === name) || CONFIG.shopItems.find((entry) => entry[0].toLowerCase().includes(name)) || null\n}\n\nfunction sellList() {\n\treturn CONFIG.sellPrices.filter((entry) => Number(entry[1]) > 0)\n}\n\n// Sells every item in sellPrices the player has, and tells them what it came to\nfunction sellAll(playerId) {\n\tconst prices = sellList()\n\tconst sold = []\n\tfor (const entry of prices) {\n\t\tlet amount = 0\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tamount = api.getInventoryItemAmount(playerId, entry[0])\n\t\t} catch (e) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (amount > 0) {\n\t\t\tsold.push(amount + " " + entry[0])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tconst earned = sold.length > 0 ? sellItems(playerId, prices) : 0\n\tif (earned > 0) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You sold " + sold.join(", ") + " for " + earned + " coins!", { color: "gold" })\n\t} else {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You have nothing to sell. "Your inventory is full, so you got your coins back." : "Your inventory only had room for " + given + " " + entry[0] + ", so you got " + back + " coins back.", { color: "orange" })\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunction buyFromShop(playerId, wanted) {\n\tconst entry = wanted === "" ? null : findShopItem(wanted)\n\tif (entry === null) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "That isn\'t in the shop. CONFIG.shopItems[Number(itemKey.slice(4)) - 1] : null\n\tif (entry) {\n\t\tgiveShopItem(playerId, entry)\n\t}\n}\n\n// A few times a second: a player who steps onto the sell pad sells once, and again on their next visit\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tsellPadMs += ms\n\tif (sellPadMs < 250) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tsellPadMs = 0\n\tconst pad = CONFIG.sellPad\n\tif (!pad || sellList().length === 0) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor (const playerId of api.getPlayerIds()) {\n\t\tconst there = isInBox(playerId, [pad[0] - 1, pad[1], pad[2] - 1], [pad[0] + 1, pad[1] + 3, pad[2] + 1])\n\t\tif (there && !onSellPad[playerId]) {\n\t\t\tonSellPad[playerId] = true\n\t\t\tsellAll(playerId)\n\t\t} else if (!there) {\n\t\t\tdelete onSellPad[playerId]\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerLeave(playerId) {\n\tdelete onSellPad[playerId]\n}\n\nfunction playerCommand(playerId, command) {\n\tconst words = command.trim().split(" ")\n\tconst name = words[0].toLowerCase()\n\t// The whole command too, so a sellCommand of two words ("sell all") works\n\tconst typed = words.filter((word) => word !== "").join(" ").toLowerCase().replace("/", "")\n\tif (name === "shop") {\n\t\tshowShop(playerId)\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tif (sellList().length > 0 && typed === CONFIG.sellCommand.trim().toLowerCase().replace("/", "")) {\n\t\tsellAll(playerId)\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tif (name === "buy") {\n\t\tbuyFromShop(playerId, words.slice(1).join(" ").trim())\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\t// Other commands return nothing: any value would stop the game\'s own (/spawn, /tprequest...)\n\treturn\n}',

+        code: '// Kill rewards: every kill gives coins and score and counts on the killer\'s sidebar. Kills in a row without dying are\n// a streak, and big streaks are told to everyone.\nconst killCounts = {}\nconst killStreaks = {}\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tkillCounts[playerId] = 0\n\tkillStreaks[playerId] = 0\n\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Kills", 0)\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerKilledOtherPlayer(attackingPlayer, killedPlayer, damageDealt, withItem) {\n\tif (attackingPlayer !== killedPlayer) {\n\t\trewardKiller(attackingPlayer, killedPlayer)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction rewardKiller(attackingPlayer, killedPlayer) {\n\tkillCounts[attackingPlayer] = (killCounts[attackingPlayer] || 0) + 1\n\tkillStreaks[attackingPlayer] = (killStreaks[attackingPlayer] || 0) + 1\n\tsetSidebar(attackingPlayer, "Kills", killCounts[attackingPlayer])\n\tif (CONFIG.killScore > 0) {\n\t\taddScore(attackingPlayer, CONFIG.killScore)\n\t}\n\tif (CONFIG.killCoins > 0) {\n\t\taddCoins(attackingPlayer, CONFIG.killCoins)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(attackingPlayer, "You beat " + api.getEntityName(killedPlayer) + "! +" + CONFIG.killCoins + " coins", { color: "lime" })\n\t}\n\tif (CONFIG.streakAnnounceAt.includes(killStreaks[attackingPlayer])) {\n\t\tapi.broadcastMessage(api.getEntityName(attackingPlayer) + " is on a " + killStreaks[attackingPlayer] + " kill streak!", { color: "orange" })\n\t}\n\tfor (const [item, amount] of CONFIG.killItems) {\n\t\tapi.giveItem(attackingPlayer, item, amount)\n\t}\n\tfor (const [streak, item, amount] of CONFIG.streakItems) {\n\t\tif (killStreaks[attackingPlayer] === streak) {\n\t\t\tapi.giveItem(attackingPlayer, item, amount)\n\t\t\tapi.sendMessage(attackingPlayer, streak + " kills in a row: you get " + amount + " " + item + "!", { color: "gold" })\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Every death, by a player or not, ends with a respawn request, which ends the streak\nfunction onRespawnRequest(playerId) {\n\tkillStreaks[playerId] = 0\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerLeave(playerId) {\n\tdelete killCounts[playerId]\n\tdelete killStreaks[playerId]\n}',

+        code: '// XP and levels: players earn XP for kills, mobs, mining and playing. Enough XP levels them up (each level needs more),\n// and their level gives them a rank, shown before their name in chat and on their sidebar. /stats shows their stats.\n// Other code can give XP with addXp(playerId, amount) and read a level with getLevel(playerId).\nconst progress = {}\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tconst load = (key, fallback) => (CONFIG.saveProgress ? Number(getSaved(playerId, key, fallback)) : fallback)\n\tprogress[playerId] = {\n\t\tlevel: Math.max(1, load("progressLevel", 1)),\n\t\txp: load("progressXp", 0),\n\t\tkills: load("progressKills", 0),\n\t\tdeaths: load("progressDeaths", 0),\n\t\tplayMs: 0,\n\t\tshownLevel: 0,\n\t}\n\tshowLevelProgress(playerId)\n}\n\nfunction xpNeeded(level) {\n\treturn Math.max(1, CONFIG.levelXpBase + CONFIG.levelXpGrowth * (level - 1))\n}\n\n// The highest rank the level has reached, as [name, level, colour], or null\nfunction rankFor(level) {\n\tlet best = null\n\tfor (const rank of CONFIG.ranks) {\n\t\tif (level >= rank[1] && (best === null || rank[1] >= best[1])) {\n\t\t\tbest = rank\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\nfunction getLevel(playerId) {\n\treturn progress[playerId] ? progress[playerId].level : 0\n}\n\n// note is optional text shown after the XP, like "+3 coins"\nfunction addXp(playerId, amount, note) {\n\tconst stats = progress[playerId]\n\tif (!stats || !(amount > 0)) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tstats.xp += amount\n\tapi.sendFlyingMiddleMessage(playerId, "+" + amount + " XP" + (note ? ", " + note : ""), 1)\n\twhile (stats.xp >= xpNeeded(stats.level)) {\n\t\tstats.xp -= xpNeeded(stats.level)\n\t\tstats.level++\n\t\tlevelUp(playerId, stats.level)\n\t}\n\tstoreProgress(playerId)\n\tshowLevelProgress(playerId)\n}\n\nfunction levelUp(playerId, level) {\n\tconst name = api.getEntityName(playerId)\n\tapi.queueMiddleTextUpper(playerId, "Level " + level + "!", 3000)\n\tapi.broadcastMessage(name + " reached level " + level + "!", { color: "gold" })\n\tif (CONFIG.levelUpCoins > 0) {\n\t\taddCoins(playerId, CONFIG.levelUpCoins)\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Level up reward: +" + CONFIG.levelUpCoins + " coins!", { color: "lime" })\n\t}\n\tconst rank = rankFor(level)\n\tif (rank && rank[1] === level) {\n\t\tapi.broadcastMessage(name + " is now a " + rank[0] + "!", { color: rank[2] })\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction storeProgress(playerId) {\n\tconst stats = progress[playerId]\n\tif (CONFIG.saveProgress && stats) {\n\t\tsetSaved(playerId, "progressLevel", stats.level)\n\t\tsetSaved(playerId, "progressXp", stats.xp)\n\t\tsetSaved(playerId, "progressKills", stats.kills)\n\t\tsetSaved(playerId, "progressDeaths", stats.deaths)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction showLevelProgress(playerId) {\n\tconst stats = progress[playerId]\n\tconst rank = rankFor(stats.level)\n\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Level", stats.level)\n\tsetSidebar(playerId, "XP", stats.xp + "/" + xpNeeded(stats.level))\n\tsetSidebar(playerId, "Rank", rank ? rank[0] : "-")\n\t// The tag under their name changes only with their level\n\tif (stats.shownLevel !== stats.level) {\n\t\tstats.shownLevel = stats.level\n\t\tconst tag = (rank ? "[" + rank[0] + "] " : "") + "Level " + stats.level\n\t\tapi.setTargetedPlayerSettingForEveryone(playerId, "nameTagInfo", { subtitle: [{ str: tag, style: { color: rank ? rank[2] : "white" } }] }, true)\n\t}\n}\n\n// The rank goes before the player\'s name in chat: [Pro] Alice: hi\nfunction onPlayerChat(playerId, chatMessage) {\n\tconst rank = progress[playerId] ? rankFor(progress[playerId].level) : null\n\tif (rank) {\n\t\treturn [[{ str: "[" + rank[0] + "]", style: { color: rank[2] } }]]\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerKilledOtherPlayer(attackingPlayer, killedPlayer) {\n\tif (attackingPlayer !== killedPlayer && progress[attackingPlayer]) {\n\t\tprogress[attackingPlayer].kills++\n\t\tstoreProgress(attackingPlayer)\n\t\taddXp(attackingPlayer, CONFIG.xpPerKill)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerKilledMob(playerId, mobId, damageDealt, withItem) {\n\tconst coins = progress[playerId] && CONFIG.coinsPerMobKill > 0 ? CONFIG.coinsPerMobKill : 0\n\tif (coins > 0) {\n\t\taddCoins(playerId, coins)\n\t\tif (!(CONFIG.xpPerMobKill > 0)) {\n\t\t\tapi.sendFlyingMiddleMessage(playerId, "+" + coins + " coins", 1)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\taddXp(playerId, CONFIG.xpPerMobKill, coins > 0 ? "+" + coins + " coins" : "")\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerChangeBlock(playerId, x, y, z, fromBlock, toBlock) {\n\tif (toBlock === "Air" && fromBlock !== "Air") {\n\t\taddXp(playerId, CONFIG.xpPerBlockBroken)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Every death ends with a respawn request\nfunction onRespawnRequest(playerId) {\n\tif (progress[playerId]) {\n\t\tprogress[playerId].deaths++\n\t\tstoreProgress(playerId)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tif (CONFIG.xpPerMinutePlayed <= 0) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor (const playerId of Object.keys(progress)) {\n\t\tprogress[playerId].playMs += ms\n\t\tif (progress[playerId].playMs >= 60000) {\n\t\t\tprogress[playerId].playMs -= 60000\n\t\t\taddXp(playerId, CONFIG.xpPerMinutePlayed)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction playerCommand(playerId, command) {\n\tconst word = command.trim().toLowerCase()\n\tconst stats = progress[playerId]\n\tif ((word !== "stats" && word !== "level" && word !== "xp") || !stats) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst rank = rankFor(stats.level)\n\tconst needed = xpNeeded(stats.level)\n\tapi.sendMessage(\n\t\tplayerId,\n\t\t"Level " + stats.level + (rank ? +        code: '// Quests: players finish quests (kill mobs, mine or place blocks, earn coins, walk) for coins and items. With\n// questsInOrder one quest is on at a time; otherwise all are. The quests on show on the sidebar, /quests lists them all,\n// and progress is saved. +        code: '// Fishing: by some water, type /fish or cast a fishing rod into it to catch a random fish from the fish table. Better\n// rods (/rods, /buyrod) catch faster. /sell, or standing on the sell pad, sells every fish for coins.\nconst fishTimers = {}\nconst fishBags = {}\nlet fishSellPadMs = 0\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tconst number = rodNumber(playerId)\n\tif (number > 0 && !api.hasItem(playerId, CONFIG.rods[number - 1][0])) {\n\t\tapi.giveItem(playerId, CONFIG.rods[number - 1][0], 1)\n\t}\n\tshowFishCount(playerId)\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Go fishing! By some water, cast your rod in or type /fish. /sell sells your fish, /rods shows better rods.", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\n// Fish and rods are counts, saved when CONFIG.saveCoins is on\nfunction fishValue(playerId, key) {\n\tif (CONFIG.saveCoins) {\n\t\treturn Number(getSaved(playerId, key, 0))\n\t}\n\treturn (fishBags[playerId] || {})[key] || 0\n}\n\nfunction setFishValue(playerId, key, value) {\n\tif (CONFIG.saveCoins) {\n\t\tsetSaved(playerId, key, value)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif (!fishBags[playerId]) {\n\t\tfishBags[playerId] = {}\n\t}\n\tfishBags[playerId][key] = value\n}\n\n// The number of the best rod a player has (1 is the first), 0 for none\nfunction rodNumber(playerId) {\n\tconst bought = fishValue(playerId, "fishingRod")\n\tif (bought > 0) {\n\t\treturn bought\n\t}\n\treturn CONFIG.rods.length > 0 && CONFIG.rods[0][2] === 0 ? 1 : 0\n}\n\nfunction catchSecondsFor(rod) {\n\treturn Math.round(CONFIG.catchSeconds * (rod ? rod[1] : 1) * 10) / 10\n}\n\nfunction pickFish() {\n\tconst total = CONFIG.fishTable.reduce((sum, fish) => sum + fish[1], 0)\n\tlet roll = Math.random() * total\n\tfor (const fish of CONFIG.fishTable) {\n\t\troll -= fish[1]\n\t\tif (roll < 0) {\n\t\t\treturn fish\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn CONFIG.fishTable[0]\n}\n\nfunction nearWater(playerId) {\n\tconst [x, y, z] = api.getPosition(playerId).map(Math.floor)\n\tconst reach = CONFIG.waterDistance\n\tfor (let dx = -reach; dx <= reach; dx++) {\n\t\tfor (let dz = -reach; dz <= reach; dz++) {\n\t\t\tfor (let dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {\n\t\t\t\tif (api.getBlock(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz) === "Water") {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\nfunction startFishing(playerId) {\n\tif (fishTimers[playerId] !== undefined) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You\'re already fishing...")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif (!nearWater(playerId)) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Stand next to water to fish!", { color: "orange" })\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst number = rodNumber(playerId)\n\tconst seconds = catchSecondsFor(number > 0 ? CONFIG.rods[number - 1] : null)\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Fishing... wait " + seconds + " seconds.", { color: "aqua" })\n\tfishTimers[playerId] = runLater(seconds, () => {\n\t\tdelete fishTimers[playerId]\n\t\tif (!nearWater(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "The fish got away! Stay by the water.", { color: "orange" })\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tcatchFish(playerId, pickFish())\n\t})\n}\n\nfunction catchFish(playerId, fish) {\n\tsetFishValue(playerId, "fish " + fish[0], fishValue(playerId, "fish " + fish[0]) + 1)\n\tshowFishCount(playerId)\n\tconst a = /^[aeiou]/i.test(fish[0]) ? " (yours)" : ""))\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Rods:\\n" + lines.join("\\n") + "\\nType /buyrod and a number, like /buyrod 2", { color: "yellow" })\n}\n\nfunction buyRod(playerId, wanted) {\n\tconst number = Number(wanted)\n\tconst index = Number.isInteger(number) && number >= 1 ? number - 1 : CONFIG.rods.findIndex((rod) => wanted !== "" && rod[0].toLowerCase().startsWith(wanted.toLowerCase()))\n\tif (index < 0 || index >= CONFIG.rods.length) {\n\t\tlistRods(playerId)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst rod = CONFIG.rods[index]\n\tif (rodNumber(playerId) > index) {\n\t\t// One they lost is given back\n\t\tif (!api.hasItem(playerId, rod[0])) {\n\t\t\tapi.giveItem(playerId, rod[0], 1)\n\t\t}\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "You already have the " + rod[0] + " or better!")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif (!spendCoins(playerId, rod[2])) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "The " + rod[0] + " costs " + rod[2] + " coins. Go fishing first!")\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tif (name === "rods") {\n\t\tlistRods(playerId)\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tif (name === "buyrod") {\n\t\tbuyRod(playerId, words.slice(1).join(" ").trim())\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tif (name === "fishbag") {\n\t\tshowFishBag(playerId)\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onPlayerLeave(playerId) {\n\tif (fishTimers[playerId] !== undefined) {\n\t\tcancelTimer(fishTimers[playerId])\n\t}\n\tdelete fishTimers[playerId]\n\tdelete fishBags[playerId]\n}',

+        code: '// Kit selector: /kits lists the kits and /kit <name> picks one. Players get their kit when they join and every time\n// they respawn, with its armour put on. A kit picked mid-fight comes at the next respawn. A kit with { cost } or\n// { level } after its items is locked until bought (kept) or the level is reached; kitCooldownMinutes spaces picks out.\nconst chosenKits = {}\nconst boughtKits = {}\nconst kitPickedAt = {}\nconst kitsDue = {}\nconst kitGivenAt = {}\nconst kitArmourSlots = { Helmet: 46, Chestplate: 47, Gauntlets: 48, Leggings: 49, Boots: 50 }\n\nfunction onPlayerJoin(playerId) {\n\tconst saved = CONFIG.saveKitChoice ? getSaved(playerId, "chosenKit", null) : null\n\tboughtKits[playerId] = String(getSaved(playerId, "kitsBought", "")).split("|").filter((name) => name !== "")\n\tkitPickedAt[playerId] = Number(getSaved(playerId, "kitPickedAt", 0))\n\tconst savedKit = findKit(String(saved || CONFIG.defaultKit))\n\t// A saved kit still owing its cost (the kits changed) falls back to the default; a level, once reached, stays reached\n\tconst owes = savedKit ? kitStillNeeds(playerId, savedKit) : null\n\tchosenKits[playerId] = savedKit && (owes === null || owes.cost === 0) ? savedKit : findKit(CONFIG.defaultKit)\n\tkitsDue[playerId] = true\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Your kit: " + kitFor(playerId)[0] + ". Type /kits to see the others.", { color: "aqua" })\n}\n\nfunction findKit(wanted) {\n\tconst number = Number(wanted)\n\tif (wanted !== "" && Number.isInteger(number) && number >= 1 && number <= CONFIG.kits.length) {\n\t\treturn CONFIG.kits[number - 1]\n\t}\n\tconst name = wanted.toLowerCase()\n\treturn CONFIG.kits.find((kit) => kit[0].toLowerCase() === name) || CONFIG.kits.find((kit) => kit[0].toLowerCase().startsWith(name)) || null\n}\n\nfunction kitFor(playerId) {\n\treturn chosenKits[playerId] || findKit(CONFIG.defaultKit) || CONFIG.kits[0]\n}\n\n// What a kit needs to unlock: { cost, level }, 0 for none. The default kit is free\nfunction kitNeeds(kit) {\n\tconst unlock = kit[2]\n\tif (kit[0] === CONFIG.defaultKit || !unlock) {\n\t\treturn { cost: 0, level: 0 }\n\t}\n\tif (typeof unlock === "number") {\n\t\treturn { cost: unlock, level: 0 }\n\t}\n\treturn { cost: Number(unlock.cost) || 0, level: Number(unlock.level) || 0 }\n}\n\n// A player\'s level from the XP and levels prefab (getLevel), or null when the game has none\nfunction kitPlayerLevel(playerId) {\n\treturn typeof getLevel === "function" ? getLevel(playerId) : null\n}\n\n// What a player still needs for a kit, { level, cost } (0: nothing), or null when it\'s theirs. A cost is paid once\nfunction kitStillNeeds(playerId, kit) {\n\tconst needs = kitNeeds(kit)\n\tconst level = kitPlayerLevel(playerId)\n\tconst missing = {\n\t\tlevel: needs.level > 0 && level !== null && level < needs.level ? needs.level : 0,\n\t\tcost: needs.cost > 0 && !(boughtKits[playerId] || []).includes(kit[0]) ? needs.cost : 0,\n\t}\n\treturn missing.level > 0 || missing.cost > 0 ? missing : null\n}\n\n// The time left before a player can pick a kit again, in ms (0: they can now)\nfunction kitWaitLeft(playerId) {\n\tif (CONFIG.kitCooldownMinutes <= 0 || !kitPickedAt[playerId]) {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\treturn Math.max(0, kitPickedAt[playerId] + CONFIG.kitCooldownMinutes * 60000 - api.now())\n}\n\nfunction kitWaitText(ms) {\n\tconst seconds = Math.ceil(ms / 1000)\n\tconst minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60)\n\treturn minutes > 0 ? minutes + "m " + (seconds % 60) + "s" : seconds + "s"\n}\n\nfunction giveChosenKit(playerId) {\n\tapi.clearInventory(playerId)\n\tfor (const entry of kitFor(playerId)[1]) {\n\t\tconst slot = kitArmourSlots[entry[0].split(" ").pop()]\n\t\ttry {\n\t\t\tif (slot !== undefined) {\n\t\t\t\tapi.setItemSlot(playerId, slot, entry[0])\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tapi.giveItem(playerId, entry[0], entry[1] || 1)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} catch (error) {\n\t\t\t// A misspelt item is left out, so the rest of the kit (and the game) still works\n\t\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, entry[0] + " isn\'t an item, so it was left out of your kit.", { color: "orange" })\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tkitGivenAt[playerId] = api.now()\n}\n\n// The kit is given a tick after joining or respawning, so it replaces any kit the game itself gives then\nfunction tick(ms) {\n\tfor (const playerId of Object.keys(kitsDue)) {\n\t\tif (api.isAlive(playerId)) {\n\t\t\tdelete kitsDue[playerId]\n\t\t\tgiveChosenKit(playerId)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunction onRespawnRequest(playerId) {\n\tkitsDue[playerId] = true\n}\n\nfunction listKits(playerId) {\n\tconst lines = CONFIG.kits.map((kit, index) => {\n\t\tconst missing = kitStillNeeds(playerId, kit)\n\t\tconst lock = missing === null ? "" : " [locked: " + [missing.level > 0 ? "level " + missing.level : "", missing.cost > 0 ? missing.cost + " coins" : ""].filter((part) => part !== "").join(", ") + "]"\n\t\treturn (index + 1) + ". " + kit[0] + lock + ": " + kit[1].map((entry) => (entry[1] || 1) + " " + entry[0]).join(", ")\n\t})\n\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "Kits (yours: " + kitFor(playerId)[0] + "):\\n" + lines.join("\\n") + "\\nType /kit and a name, like /kit " + CONFIG.kits[CONFIG.kits.length - 1][0], { color: "yellow" })\n}\n\nfunction pickKit(playerId, wanted) {\n\tconst kit = wanted === "" ? null : findKit(wanted)\n\tif (kit === null) {\n\t\tlistKits(playerId)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tconst missing = kitStillNeeds(playerId, kit)\n\tif (missing !== null && missing.level > 0) {\n\t\tapi.sendMessage(playerId, "The " + kit[0] + " kit unlocks at level " + missing.level + ".
